title: Offline benchmark library verification
subject: Developer tools
question: How long does it take to verify the generated catalog locally?
finding: An up-to-date build took 0.339 s and check took 0.268 s across 311 records.
method: One warm invocation per command on an already-generated archive, timed from process creation through successful exit using Python perf_counter. This report was added after measurement.
workload: Validate 311 reports and compare their generated pages and indexes with the existing files.
